description: What changes when upgrading an npm package from one version to another: removed exports and modules, changed function signatures and class members, newly deprecated APIs, changed engines/peerDependencies, and changelog sections in between. Computed from the TypeScript types of both versions. Use BEFORE upgrading a dependency or when code written for an older version fails on a newer one. Versions can be exact ("14.2.3") or a major ("14"); "to" defaults to latest.

from.description: Current version or major, e.g. "14" or "14.2.3"

to.description: Target version or major; default: latest

name: upgrade_impact
title: Upgrade impact (what breaks)
